title.zh: Bitcoin, ether swing after unanimous quarter-point Fed rate hike as Warsh takes aim at inflation
title.en: Bitcoin, ether swing after unanimous quarter-point Fed rate hike as Warsh takes aim at inflation

current_state.zh: 美联储于9月16日加息25个基点至3.75%-4.00%，主席沃什发表鹰派言论后，高盛预计10月将再次加息，交易员定价超过50%的加息概率。
current_state.en: After the Fed hiked 25 basis points to 3.75%-4.00% on Sept 16 and Chair Warsh struck a hawkish tone, Goldman Sachs now expects another hike in October, with traders pricing just over 50% chance.

updates.title_zh: Goldman pivots, now forecasts Fed rate hike in October
updates.title_en: Goldman pivots, now forecasts Fed rate hike in October
updates.what_changed_zh: 高盛改变预测，现在预计美联储将在10月再次加息，逆转此前预测。
updates.what_changed_en: Goldman Sachs now expects another Fed rate hike in October, reversing its prior forecast.
updates.current_state_zh: 美联储于9月16日加息25个基点至3.75%-4.00%，主席沃什发表鹰派言论后，高盛预计10月将再次加息，交易员定价超过50%的加息概率。
updates.current_state_en: After the Fed hiked 25 basis points to 3.75%-4.00% on Sept 16 and Chair Warsh struck a hawkish tone, Goldman Sachs now expects another hike in October, with traders pricing just over 50% chance.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Goldman Sachs now expects the Federal Reserve to raise interest rates again in October, reversing its prior call for a September hike followed by a pause, after the Fed hiked rates to 3.75%-4.00% and Chair Kevin Warsh struck a hawkish tone.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Goldman Sachs now expects the Federal Reserve to raise interest rates again in October, reversing its prior call for a September hike followed by a pause, after the Fed hiked rates to 3.75%-4.00% and Chair Kevin Warsh struck a hawkish tone.
